changeSet.sql: IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'metrics' AND TABLE_NAME = 'Allocation') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [metrics].[Allocation]( [Uid] uniqueidentifier NOT NULL, [ScoreType] int NOT NULL, [AssetTypeUid] uniqueidentifier NOT NULL, [OverrideName] [nvarchar](250) NULL, [State] int NOT NULL CONSTRAINT [DF_MetricAllocation_State] DEFAULT ((1)), [CreatedOn] [datetime] NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_MetricAllocation_CreatedOn DEFAULT getutcdate(), [CreatedBy] [int] NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_MetricAllocation_CreatedBy DEFAULT(0), [UpdatedOn] [datetime] NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_MetricAllocation_UpdatedOn DEFAULT getutcdate(), [UpdatedBy] [int] NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_MetricAllocation_UpdatedBy DEFAULT(0), CONSTRAINT [PK_MetricAllocation] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( AssetTypeUid ASC, ScoreType ASC ) ) END
